Skip to main content What if your passion for technology could take you straight into Canada’s top universities, without draining your bank account? But here’s the reality: Canada is rolling out incredible IT scholarships in 2025/26 , designed specifically for international students like you who want to transform their tech dreams into reality. Now, the big question is, which scholarships are worth your time, energy, and effort? That’s where this guide comes in. I’ve curated the Top 20 IT Scholarships in Canada for 2025/26 fully funded and partial awards, all available online to apply for. Why Canada for IT Studies? Before we jump into the scholarships, let’s pause for a second. Why is everyone rushing to Canada for IT programs? Canada’s tech industry is booming, with major hubs in Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal, and Waterloo. Universities here are globally recognized for computer science, AI, data analytics, cybersecurity, and software engineering. International students can benefit from post-study work permits and high-paying job opportunities. Top 20 IT Scholarships in Canada for 2025/26 Here’s the list you’ve been waiting for. Bookmark this, because these scholarships are the keys to your next big chapter: 1. Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships (Vanier CGS) One of the most prestigious scholarships in Canada. Designed for top-tier PhD candidates in IT, computer science, and related fields. Funding: CAD $50,000 per year for 3 years. 2. University of Toronto Lester B. Pearson Scholarship For exceptional undergraduate students pursuing IT and computer science. Recognizes leadership, creativity, and academic excellence. Coverage: Full tuition, books, and living expenses. 3. University of Waterloo International Master’s Award of Excellence Perfect for IT and computer science graduate students. Funding: CAD $2,500 per term. 4. McGill University Scholarships Offers merit-based awards for IT, software engineering, and AI-related programs. Coverage: Partial to full tuition. 5. UBC International Leader of Tomorrow Award For undergraduates with outstanding academic and leadership qualities, including IT students. Coverage: Full tuition and living expenses. 6. Simon Fraser University (SFU) Entrance Scholarships Targeted toward tech-focused students with excellent grades. Funding: CAD $5,000 – CAD $10,000. 7. York University International Student Scholarships Offers scholarships for IT-related bachelor’s and master’s programs. Funding: CAD $20,000 annually (renewable). 8. Carleton University Richard Van Loon Award For African international students in IT and computer science. Funding: CAD $5,000. 9. University of Ottawa Excellence Scholarships For undergraduate IT and computer science students. Coverage: CAD $4,000 – CAD $10,000 annually. 10. University of Calgary International Entrance Scholarship Available for undergraduate IT students. Funding: CAD $15,000 annually. Western University International President’s Entrance Scholarship Prestigious undergraduate scholarship for tech and IT programs. Funding: CAD $50,000 total. 12. Queen’s University International Admission Scholarship For students pursuing IT-related programs. Funding: CAD $10,000. 13. Concordia University International Excellence Tuition Award Helps IT undergraduates and postgraduates cover tuition fees. Coverage: Partial tuition. 14. Dalhousie University Scholarships Offers a range of funding for IT, computer science, and data programs. Coverage: CAD $2,000 – CAD $10,000. 15. University of Manitoba Graduate Fellowship (UMGF) For master’s and PhD students in IT and computer science. Funding: CAD $14,000 – CAD $18,000 per year. 16. University of Saskatchewan International Excellence Award For undergraduates in IT and related fields. Funding: CAD $10,000. 17. Ryerson University International Student Merit Scholarships For undergraduates pursuing computer science and IT. Funding: CAD $5,000 – CAD $10,000. 18. University of Victoria Graduate Awards Supports master’s students in IT programs. Funding: CAD $10,000 annually. 19. Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships For advanced IT research in Canada. Funding: CAD $70,000 per year. 20. Mitacs Globalink Research Award For IT students conducting research in Canada. Funding: CAD $6,000. How to Apply for IT Scholarships in Canada Now you’ve seen the top scholarships—but how do you secure one? Start early: Most deadlines fall between November and February. Prepare strong documents: Academic transcripts, CV, reference letters, and a statement of purpose. Highlight your IT projects: Showcase coding, AI, data, or tech projects in your portfolio. Apply online: Most universities and Canadian government portals accept applications digitally. Stay consistent: Apply to multiple scholarships to maximize your chances. Final Thoughts Here’s the bottom line: Canada is calling, and IT scholarships are the golden key. Whether you’re an undergraduate ready to explore tech or a postgraduate dreaming of cutting-edge AI research, these 20 scholarships could transform your academic and professional journey. Imagine graduating debt-free. Imagine networking with top tech companies. Imagine building your career in one of the world’s fastest-growing industries, all starting with a scholarship in Canada. Start preparing today, polish your documents, and leap. Because in 2025/26, Canada isn’t just offering scholarships… It’s offering you a future.
